description: Unit test class for InMemoryDictionary, testing suggestion retrieval, addition, deletion restrictions, and handling of different input scenarios.

classes.name: InMemoryDictionaryTest
classes.description: Test suite for the InMemoryDictionary class, verifying suggestion logic, restrictions on storage modification, and handling of different input cases.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes dictionaries with sample data before each test.

methods.name: testCanNotDeleteFromStorage
methods.description: Verifies that deleting words from storage throws an UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: testCanNotAddToStorage
methods.description: Verifies that adding words to storage throws an UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: testGetWord
methods.description: Tests suggestion retrieval without including the typed word.

methods.name: testGetWordWithIncluded
methods.description: Tests suggestion retrieval including the typed word.

methods.name: testGetWordWithCaps
methods.description: Tests suggestion retrieval with a capitalized typed word.

methods.name: testGetWordNearBy
methods.description: Tests suggestion retrieval for a near-miss typed word.
